comment: Authoritative declarations for StageBinding.read() fields. Run `python tools/generate_read_fields.py --write` after editing. The generator validates this file and writes ovnewton/_src/_output_descriptors.py and docs/site/read-fields.md.

fields.name: body_q
fields.summary: Body pose: world position of the body origin and world orientation.
fields.layout: One row per body. Position, then an XYZW unit quaternion.
fields.units: Position in model length units. The quaternion has no units.
fields.frame: World frame. The position is the body origin, not the center of mass.

fields.name: body_qd
fields.summary: Body twist: linear velocity of the center of mass, then angular velocity.
fields.layout: One row per body. Linear velocity, then angular velocity.
fields.units: Linear velocity in model length units per second. Angular velocity in radians per second.
fields.frame: World frame. The linear velocity is that of the center of mass.

fields.name: body_mass
fields.summary: Body mass, as stored by Newton.
fields.layout: One value per body.
fields.units: Model mass units.

fields.name: body_inertia
fields.summary: Body inertia matrix about the center of mass, as stored by Newton.
fields.layout: One row-major 3x3 matrix per body.
fields.units: Model mass units times model length units squared.
fields.frame: Body frame, about the center of mass.

fields.name: body_com
fields.summary: Center-of-mass offset from the body origin, as stored by Newton.
fields.layout: One row per body.
fields.units: Model length units.
fields.frame: Body frame.

fields.name: body_qdd
fields.summary: Body acceleration: linear acceleration of the center of mass, then angular acceleration.
fields.layout: One row per body. Linear acceleration, then angular acceleration. The caller must allocate State.body_qdd and use a solver that fills it.
fields.units: Linear acceleration in model length units per second squared. Angular acceleration in radians per second squared.
fields.frame: World frame. The acceleration is that of the center of mass.

fields.name: position
fields.summary: World position of the body origin, split from body_q.
fields.layout: One row per selected body.
fields.units: Model length units.
fields.frame: World frame. The position is the body origin, not the center of mass.

fields.name: orientation
fields.summary: World orientation of the body, split from body_q.
fields.layout: One XYZW unit quaternion per selected body.
fields.units: None. The quaternion has unit length.
fields.frame: World frame.

fields.name: linearVelocity
fields.summary: Linear velocity of the body's center of mass, split from body_qd.
fields.layout: One row per selected body.
fields.units: Model length units per second.
fields.frame: World frame. The velocity is that of the center of mass.

fields.name: angularVelocity
fields.summary: Angular velocity of the body, split from body_qd.
fields.layout: One row per selected body.
fields.units: Radians per second.
fields.frame: World frame.

fields.name: linearAcceleration
fields.summary: Linear acceleration of the body's center of mass, split from body_qdd.
fields.layout: One row per selected body. The caller must allocate State.body_qdd and use a solver that fills it.
fields.units: Model length units per second squared.
fields.frame: World frame. The acceleration is that of the center of mass.

fields.name: angularAcceleration
fields.summary: Angular acceleration of the body, split from body_qdd.
fields.layout: One row per selected body. The caller must allocate State.body_qdd and use a solver that fills it.
fields.units: Radians per second squared.
fields.frame: World frame.

fields.name: gravity
fields.summary: Effective gravity vector of the physics scene.
fields.layout: One row: the Newton world row that the bound bodies use. A read fails when no single row applies.
fields.units: Model length units per second squared.
fields.frame: World frame.

fields.name: mass
fields.summary: Final body mass.
fields.layout: One value per body.
fields.units: Model mass units.

fields.name: inertia
fields.summary: Final body inertia matrix about the center of mass.
fields.layout: One row-major 3x3 matrix per body.
fields.units: Model mass units times model length units squared.
fields.frame: Body frame, about the center of mass.

fields.name: centerOfMassPosition
fields.summary: Center-of-mass offset from the body origin.
fields.layout: One row per body.
fields.units: Model length units.
fields.frame: Body frame.

fields.name: shapeCount
fields.summary: Number of collision shapes attached to the body.
fields.layout: One count per selected body.
fields.units: None.

fields.name: friction
fields.summary: Friction coefficient of each shape on the body.
fields.lanes_rule: The largest shapeCount among the selected bodies, at most 255.
fields.layout: One row per selected body. Shapes follow Newton shape order. Rows are padded with zeros after shapeCount values.
fields.units: None.

fields.name: restitution
fields.summary: Restitution coefficient of each shape on the body.
fields.lanes_rule: The largest shapeCount among the selected bodies, at most 255.
fields.layout: One row per selected body. Shapes follow Newton shape order. Rows are padded with zeros after shapeCount values.
fields.units: None.

fields.name: rootPosition
fields.summary: World position of the articulation's root body origin.
fields.identity: The prim with the authored articulation-root API. Values come from the root body.
fields.layout: One row per selected articulation.
fields.units: Model length units.
fields.frame: World frame. The position is the root body origin.

fields.name: rootOrientation
fields.summary: World orientation of the articulation's root body.
fields.identity: The prim with the authored articulation-root API. Values come from the root body.
fields.layout: One XYZW unit quaternion per selected articulation.
fields.units: None. The quaternion has unit length.
fields.frame: World frame.

fields.name: rootLinearVelocity
fields.summary: Linear velocity of the articulation root body's center of mass.
fields.identity: The prim with the authored articulation-root API. Values come from the root body.
fields.layout: One row per selected articulation.
fields.units: Model length units per second.
fields.frame: World frame. The velocity is that of the root body's center of mass.

fields.name: rootAngularVelocity
fields.summary: Angular velocity of the articulation's root body.
fields.identity: The prim with the authored articulation-root API. Values come from the root body.
fields.layout: One row per selected articulation.
fields.units: Radians per second.
fields.frame: World frame.

fields.name: joint_q
fields.summary: Newton joint coordinates.
fields.identity: The bound joint prim. Fixed joints have no coordinates and produce no row.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's coordinate count, from Model.joint_q_start. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: Newton's coordinate order for the joint type. Ball joints store an XYZW quaternion. Free and distance joints store XYZ, then an XYZW quaternion. D6 joints store linear coordinates before angular ones.
fields.units: Linear coordinates in model length units. Angular coordinates in radians. Quaternions have no units.
fields.frame: Newton joint frames: the child joint frame relative to the parent joint frame.

fields.name: joint_qd
fields.summary: Newton joint velocities, one per degree of freedom.
fields.identity: The bound joint prim. Fixed joints have no degrees of freedom and produce no row.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count, from Model.joint_qd_start. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: Newton's degree-of-freedom order for the joint type. Ball joints have three angular rates, not quaternion derivatives. Free and distance joints have linear velocity, then angular velocity.
fields.units: Linear rates in model length units per second. Angular rates in radians per second.
fields.frame: Newton joint frames. Free and distance joint velocities use the parent joint frame.

fields.name: joint_f
fields.summary: Commanded joint effort, one per degree of freedom. This is an input to the solver, not a measured force.
fields.identity: The bound joint prim. Fixed joints have no degrees of freedom and produce no row.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count, from Model.joint_qd_start. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: Same order as joint_qd.
fields.units: Force on linear degrees of freedom. Torque on angular degrees of freedom. Both use model mass and length units.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes, in Newton's parent-to-child body order. Free and distance joints use a world-frame force, then a torque about the child's center of mass.

fields.name: joint_target_q
fields.summary: Current joint position targets, in Newton units.
fields.identity: The bound articulation joint prim. Only revolute, prismatic and scalar-coordinate D6 joints produce rows.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's axis count, from Model.joint_target_q_start. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: One value per axis. Linear axes come before angular axes.
fields.units: Linear axes in model length units. Angular axes in radians.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes, in Newton's parent-to-child body order.

fields.name: joint_target_qd
fields.summary: Current joint velocity targets, in Newton units.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count, from Model.joint_qd_start. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: One value per axis. Linear axes come before angular axes.
fields.units: Linear axes in model length units per second. Angular axes in radians per second.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes, in Newton's parent-to-child body order.

fields.name: joint_target_ke
fields.summary: Drive stiffness (position gain) per degree of freedom, in Newton units.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: Same order as joint_qd.
fields.units: Linear axes: force per model length unit. Angular axes: torque per radian.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes, in Newton's parent-to-child body order.

fields.name: joint_target_kd
fields.summary: Drive damping (velocity gain) per degree of freedom, in Newton units.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: Same order as joint_qd.
fields.units: Linear axes: force per (model length unit per second). Angular axes: torque per (radian per second).
fields.frame: Newton joint axes, in Newton's parent-to-child body order.

fields.name: joint_limit_lower
fields.summary: Lower joint limit per degree of freedom, in Newton units.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: Same order as joint_qd. Newton stores a missing bound as a large value, at least 1e10 in magnitude.
fields.units: Linear axes in model length units. Angular axes in radians.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes, in Newton's parent-to-child body order.

fields.name: joint_limit_upper
fields.summary: Upper joint limit per degree of freedom, in Newton units.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: Same order as joint_qd. Newton stores a missing bound as a large value, at least 1e10 in magnitude.
fields.units: Linear axes in model length units. Angular axes in radians.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes, in Newton's parent-to-child body order.

fields.name: joint_velocity_limit
fields.summary: Joint velocity limit per degree of freedom, in Newton units.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: Same order as joint_qd.
fields.units: Linear axes in model length units per second. Angular axes in radians per second.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes, in Newton's parent-to-child body order.

fields.name: joint_effort_limit
fields.summary: Joint effort limit per degree of freedom, as stored by Newton.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: Same order as joint_qd.
fields.units: Force on linear degrees of freedom. Torque on angular degrees of freedom. Both use model mass and length units.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes.

fields.name: joint_armature
fields.summary: Joint armature per degree of freedom, as stored by Newton.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: Same order as joint_qd.
fields.units: Mass on linear degrees of freedom. Moment of inertia on angular degrees of freedom. Both use model mass and length units.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes.

fields.name: joint_friction
fields.summary: Joint friction effort per degree of freedom, as stored by Newton.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: Same order as joint_qd.
fields.units: Force on linear degrees of freedom. Torque on angular degrees of freedom. Both use model mass and length units.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes.

fields.name: jointPosition
fields.summary: Joint positions per axis, with angular axes in degrees.
fields.identity: The bound articulation joint prim. Only revolute, prismatic and scalar-coordinate D6 joints produce rows.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's axis count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: One value per axis. Linear axes come before angular axes.
fields.units: Linear axes in model length units. Angular axes in degrees.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes. The sign follows the authored USD body order (physics:body0 to physics:body1).
fields.conversion: Angular axes are converted from radians to degrees. Values are negated when Newton reversed the authored body order.

fields.name: jointVelocity
fields.summary: Joint velocities per axis, with angular axes in degrees per second.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: One value per axis. Linear axes come before angular axes. Ball joints have three angular axes.
fields.units: Linear axes in model length units per second. Angular axes in degrees per second.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes. The sign follows the authored USD body order (physics:body0 to physics:body1).
fields.conversion: Angular axes are converted from radians to degrees. Values are negated when Newton reversed the authored body order.

fields.name: jointPositionTarget
fields.summary: Joint position targets per axis, with angular axes in degrees.
fields.identity: The bound articulation joint prim. Only revolute, prismatic and scalar-coordinate D6 joints produce rows.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's axis count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: One value per axis. Linear axes come before angular axes.
fields.units: Linear axes in model length units. Angular axes in degrees.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes. The sign follows the authored USD body order (physics:body0 to physics:body1).
fields.conversion: Angular axes are converted from radians to degrees. Values are negated when Newton reversed the authored body order.

fields.name: jointVelocityTarget
fields.summary: Joint velocity targets per axis, with angular axes in degrees per second.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: One value per axis. Linear axes come before angular axes.
fields.units: Linear axes in model length units per second. Angular axes in degrees per second.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes. The sign follows the authored USD body order (physics:body0 to physics:body1).
fields.conversion: Angular axes are converted from radians to degrees. Values are negated when Newton reversed the authored body order.

fields.name: jointStiffness
fields.summary: Joint position gain (drive stiffness) per axis, with angular axes per degree.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: One value per axis. Linear axes come before angular axes.
fields.units: Linear axes: force per model length unit. Angular axes: torque per degree.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes.
fields.conversion: Angular axes are converted from per-radian to per-degree units (divided by 180/pi).

fields.name: jointDamping
fields.summary: Joint velocity gain (drive damping) per axis, with angular axes per degree per second.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: One value per axis. Linear axes come before angular axes.
fields.units: Linear axes: force per (model length unit per second). Angular axes: torque per (degree per second).
fields.frame: Newton joint axes.
fields.conversion: Angular axes are converted from per-radian to per-degree units (divided by 180/pi).

fields.name: jointLimit
fields.summary: Joint lower and upper limits per axis, with angular axes in degrees.
fields.lanes_rule: Twice the joint's degree-of-freedom count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: A low value and a high value for each axis, interleaved: [low0, high0, low1, high1, ...]. Linear axes come before angular axes. A missing bound is the largest float32 value, with a sign.
fields.units: Linear axes in model length units. Angular axes in degrees.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes. Bounds follow the authored USD body order (physics:body0 to physics:body1).
fields.conversion: Angular axes are converted from radians to degrees. Bounds are negated and swapped when Newton reversed the authored body order.

fields.name: jointMaxVelocity
fields.summary: Joint velocity limit per axis, with angular axes in degrees per second.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: One value per axis. Linear axes come before angular axes.
fields.units: Linear axes in model length units per second. Angular axes in degrees per second.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes.
fields.conversion: Angular axes are converted from radians to degrees.

fields.name: jointMaxForce
fields.summary: Joint effort limit per degree of freedom.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: Same order as joint_qd.
fields.units: Force on linear degrees of freedom. Torque on angular degrees of freedom. Both use model mass and length units.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes.

fields.name: jointArmature
fields.summary: Joint armature per degree of freedom.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: Same order as joint_qd.
fields.units: Mass on linear degrees of freedom. Moment of inertia on angular degrees of freedom. Both use model mass and length units.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes.

fields.name: jointFriction
fields.summary: Joint friction effort per degree of freedom.
fields.lanes_rule: The joint's degree-of-freedom count. Joints with different counts produce separate columns.
fields.layout: Same order as joint_qd.
fields.units: Force on linear degrees of freedom. Torque on angular degrees of freedom. Both use model mass and length units.
fields.frame: Newton joint axes.
